author: DJI
description:
On Mount Qomolangma, DJI wasn't there to conquer. We were there to understand.

Flight coordinates rewritten at 8,848.86 meters. The Khumbu Glacier, modeled in full. Digital scientific research, completed at 8,861 meters. An aerial passage, delivering over 10 tons of supplies.

The extreme is our measuring stick — and it measures our soul.

No shortcuts. Only the harder path. This is the geek's way. It always has been.

title: On Mount Qomolangma, DJI wasn't there to conquer. We were there to understand.
